resources.string: Share logs
Logs, crash reports and device details in one file
Share logs?
Logs can contain chat IDs and names. Send them privately, and only to XGram admins.
This file also has XGram\'s TDLib log, which contains the text of your messages and people\'s names and phone numbers.

**XGram** was unable to display some notifications for this account due to an unknown system error.

Please make sure:
• All system updates are installed
• XGram is up to date
• There are no notification restrictions in system settings.

If this keeps happening, open Settings, tap the version, tap Share logs and send the file privately to an XGram admin (ask in Support in @XGramTD who to send it to).
